Chapter 2 of 8 • Visual IDE & Wizards

12-View Tree-First Visual IDE & 5 Guided AeroWizards

InstallerStudio.exe pairs a categorized 12-view SysTreeView32 navigation sidebar (with 32-bit premultiplied ARGB vector icons and DarkMode_Explorer chevrons) with an in-memory lossless Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). Whenever you change a field, reorder a feature, or import a .reg script, only the targeted AST lines update while every ; comment, # comment, and @include directive stays intact.

The 12 Categorized Workspace Views

  1. Package & Identity: Product name, tagline, 3-part MSI version (Major.Minor.Build), publisher, permanent UpgradeCode GUID, and install scope (machine vs. user).
  2. Application Runtimes & .MSM: Hierarchical tree of Pre-MSI [Prerequisite.*] runtimes and 64-bit [MergeModule.*] (.msm) libraries.
  3. Features: Dedicated All Features hierarchy tree with Move Up / Move Down SelectionTree display ordering, + New Feature, + Sub-Feature, DisallowAbsent core locks, and a live Feature Description inspector.
  4. Files & Folders: Dual-tree explorer pairing the 9-root Destination Computer folder tree on the left with a filtered Staged Contents & KeyPath tree on the right.
  5. Components & KeyPaths: Visual Features -> Sub-Features -> Components -> KeyPaths tree with live click-to-inspect editing.
  6. Registry: RegEdit-style target hive/subkey folder tree (HKCR, HKCU, HKLM, HKU, and HKMU) on the left, typed REG_SZ / REG_EXPAND_SZ / REG_DWORD values on the right, per-Feature filtering, and one-click .REG file importing.
  7. File Associations: Hierarchical .ext -> ProgId -> Shell Verbs tree supporting clean HKMU\Software\Classes or advertised MSI tables.
  8. Shortcuts: Dedicated Start Menu and Desktop shortcut folder hierarchy with automatic ICE38 KeyPaths.
  9. C++ Wizard Designer: Real-time GDI+ preview of SetupWizard.exe across standard Glass, aerowizard, and autorun16x9 layouts.
  10. MSI.DLL Dialog Designer: Visual 370x270 DLU canvas for relational Windows Installer Dialog and Control SQL tables.
  11. Signing, .MST & .MSP: Configure Dual-Layer Authenticode signing and generate GPO Transforms (.mst) or Patch Packages (.msp).
  12. .RSIP Source (AST): Direct monospace source editor synchronized live with every visual view.

Five Guided Native AeroWizards

  • New Project Assistant (Ctrl+W): Creates a complete .rsip manifest with fresh GUIDs, payload discovery, and shortcuts in five steps.
  • Runtime Prerequisite & .MSM Wizard: Adds curated or custom runtime installers and Merge Modules with automatic exit-code handling.
  • Component & KeyPath Wizard: Guides you through Microsoft's Single-Directory and HKCU profile KeyPath rules.
  • File Association Wizard: Maps document extensions, icons, and shell verbs cleanly to your main executable.
  • Release, Transform (.MST) & Patch (.MSP) Wizard: Builds release artifacts, VPAT 2.5 reports, and binary database diffs.

Essential IDE Keyboard Shortcuts

ShortcutAction
F1Opens RaggieSoftHelp.exe directly to the topic matching your active IDE view via Named Pipe IPC.
Ctrl+WLaunches the 5-step New Project AeroWizard.
F7Runs instbuild.exe --validate and prints structured diagnostics in the bottom console.
F5Compiles the standalone .msi and self-extracting Setup.exe bootstrapper.
F6Compiles a reusable 64-bit Windows Installer Merge Module (.msm).
